title: verify_auth_ui_rendering
description: Test the /auth endpoint to ensure the authentication UI renders correctly with support for login, registration, and optional MFA. Verify that the UI is responsive and provides clear error feedback.

title: verify_discover_ui_rendering
description: Test the /discover endpoint to confirm the discover screen loads properly, allowing users to view profiles and perform liking actions.

title: verify_matches_ui_rendering
description: Test the /matches endpoint to ensure the matches screen displays correctly, showing accurate matches based on user interactions.

title: verify_chat_ui_rendering
description: Test the /chat endpoint to verify the chat UI renders correctly for real-time messaging and that access is restricted when no valid session exists.

title: verify_chat_ui_rendering_with_id
description: Test the /chat/{id} endpoint to ensure the chat UI loads properly for a specific profile or chat ID, supporting real-time communication.

title: verify_tokens_ui_rendering
description: Test the /tokens endpoint to confirm the tokens dashboard and UI render correctly, displaying CMPX/GTK balances and supporting smooth navigation.

title: verify_landing_page_ui_rendering
description: Test the / endpoint to ensure the landing/home UI renders correctly with responsive navigation and UX across devices.

title: verify_demo_ui_rendering
description: Test the /demo endpoint to verify the demo mode UI renders correctly, allowing quick product tours without real credentials.

title: verify_profiles_list_ui_rendering
description: Test the /profiles endpoint to ensure the profiles list UI loads correctly, supporting single and couple profiles.

title: verify_profile_detail_ui_rendering
description: Test the /profile/{id} endpoint to confirm the profile detail UI renders properly for a given profile ID.
